rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with an expanded Day 5 blastocyst and thin zona, but it speculates that the reported 3BA may be optimistic and comments on ICM/TE cohesion beyond what a single static image can reliably support.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, uterine factor diagnosis, smoking, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis tied to embryo quality, age, uterine factor, and smoking; only minor overemphasis on uncertain uterine details lowers it slightly.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice guidelines: single embryo transfer at age 33, no routine bed rest, selective rather than automatic PGT-A, and uterine cavity optimization; minor speculative testing suggestions prevent a perfect score.
Provides clear next steps for transfer, lifestyle optimization, uterine-factor reassessment, and future-cycle planning with practical and case-specific detail.
